_doc: EXTERNAL cluster seed for clusters.py (steps 2-3 of the orient-scope skill). Pins the out-of-corpus half of a cluster harvest: vocabulary a corpus sweep CANNOT derive (0-hit neighborhoods, e.g. Zilber-Pink) is LLM-curated ONCE into this file — the canonical_objects.json gather+validate precedent — then every sweep re-run is deterministic against the pinned list. provenance tags the CURATION origin (MEMORY = model-knowledge framing, CORPUS = lifted from corpus docs); current corpus truth is re-measured by every sweep, never assumed from the tag. Entries are selected by scope match (--seed-scope, else the --out slug); scope 'global' always applies. Internal vocabulary is NOT seeded here — clusters.py derives it from concepts.json + touched objects on every run.
